notes.title: Frosty Fixings World Update OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=BJs6gHyydMw;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]How To Start[/b]
If you have already beaten the Boss in World 3, the first time you load the game and enter the shop, a cutscene of 4-1 unlocking will appear. If you have yet to beat the World 3 Boss, world 4 will simply unlock naturally after you do so.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42645494/92536482d1ea1cf6563636dcc51c90f3fc35c04a.png[/img]


[b]Early Acesss Current State[/b]
The game is now fully complete. It can now be beaten from start to finish. All steam achievements are now achieveable! 


[b]What has been added?[/b]
Below is everything that has been added in the Frosty Fixings update-

• 12 New levels to beat.

• 1,260 Pieces of Scrap to Accumulate

• 208 Viruses to destroy and Squish.

• 21 Microchips to find.

• 12 Collectable Cards.

• 1 Music tracks for Bit's and Bot's.

• 2 Spray Paints for Bolts appearance.

• 2 Staff Members to hire.

• 7 Golden Tills to smash.

• New Tools and Upgrades for Bolt such as Paint Brush which allows Bolt to bring blueprints to life and some Ice Skates which allow Bolt to skate on ice and grind on rails.

• New section of the Hub World has been added.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42645494/e01a129ca36b26a0b9755b85e876a138e455d4d2.png[/img]


[b]Gameplay Reminders For Returning Players[/b]

• Press Key E or Xbox Y to interact with things such as Switches, Ladders, Chests, Bolts rocket etc

• Portal objects must be rolled into to be destroyed. Press Key CTRL or Xbox B to roll.

• To inspect what upgrades Bolt has on press Tab or the Xbox directional pad. (This will also show some controls in game)

• You can change the tools you have collected by pressing the keyboard number keys or the Xbox directional pad.

• Rolling in the air allows you to jump a tiny bit further. This will be useful in some of the levels in world 4!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42645494/25138b09d4e242469a29071e18985d393b13feda.png[/img]


[b]Levels Ammount Changes.[/b]

Originally the game was meant to launch with just over 50 levels, but i think it's best to smooth out the levels which have already been made and fix any remaining minor bugs for the final release. The game will now fully launch with 48 levels. The games completion time is estimated at  15 - 20 hours.


[b]Thank You Everyone![/b]

Thanks to everyone who has been playing during early access. Bolt Bot has been in development for nearly 5 years now and it definitely would not be in the state its currently in without the feedback you have been sending through emails etc. If you do find any remaining bugs please get in contact at dreamsafeconnect@hotmail.com There is also a new thread in the Bolt Bot Steam forums for any bugs or issues found in World 4 Frosty Fixings. Thanks again!


Thanks 
All the best
Chris

notes.title: Bolt Bot Environment Update!
notes.notes:
Bolt Bot V2.1 brings a major environment update to World 1 Connection Shores and World 2 Western Wires to match the same level of quality found in the areas of World 3 Spooky Sparks.

Every single level in the two worlds has been visually improved, new fog, new particle emitters, rocks, plants, trees, grass and new 3D scenic backgrounds fitting the theme of each level all make an appearance. Where ever you look in each of the 24 levels from the first couple of worlds in the game, there will be something new in sight. 

Here is the trailer 
[previewyoutube=ilyQ_BKiF74;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you again for your continued support and i hope you enjoy this update. Hopefully with this massive update, it will make a full playthrough of Bolt Bot more visually appealing and seamless throughout.

notes.title: (Scrap Optimization Patch) Bolt Bot Screwy Viruses Early Access V1.2
notes.notes:
Here is what has changed in Early Access 1.2

• Scrap has now been optimized. Some computers (mainly laptops) had a lag spike of 0.2 seconds each time Bolt collected some Scrap. This has now been fixed.

• Changed a couple of objects in Bit's and Bot's. The shop should now have a slight fps increase.

• W1-1 Manual Farms Treasure Chest Tutorial Fixed.

• Bolts Rolling Tutorial appears sooner in W1-1.

• Some blocks have changed to stone in W1-1 to make it visually more obvious that you need the jump boots to reach higher locations.
